text: Bitcoin is holding steady near recent highs while Ethereum and most altcoins are pulling back, indicating traders are rotating into the largest asset as sentiment tilts toward greed. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 59 with a week-long decline suggests bullish confidence is cooling despite price support, and Bitcoin's rising dominance to 59.2% reflects this flight to safety. Total volume at $113B remains solid but the divergence between BTC's resilience and altcoins' weakness hints at cautious positioning rather than conviction.
